summary:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Current task (read-only diagnosis, step 1): "你是资深审查员。当前工作区是插件发布审计器 relaudit。请审查 src/audit/ 与 public/、src/render-panel.js 的正确性缺陷，把问题清单写到 REVIEW.md（格式：| 编号 | 位置 | 损害 | 修复建议 | 严重度 |）。本步骤只写 REVIEW.md，不改任何代码。完成后以 DONE 开头报告条目数。"
- Sequence of prior turns: (1) fix frontend in `public/`+`src/render-panel.js`; (2) fix backend in `src/audit/` (semver, severity, new R8 files-field); (3) write `release-notes-v1.3.0.md`; (4) write `docs/quickstart.md`. All prior turns complete.

## Key Technical Concepts
- ESM modules; Node 25.7.0 (path-resolution quirk: `node --test tests/` fails with "Cannot find module '...\workspace\tests'").
- Audit rules R1–R8 with severity mapping (R1 error, R2 error, R3 warn, R4 warn, R5 warn, R6 warn, R7 warn, R8 error; unknown → info).
- `runAudit(pkgDir, opts)` in `src/audit/index.js` orchestrates all rules, decorates findings, sorts by severity.
- Tarball entries are `package/...` paths; `listTarballEntries` (ustar reader, gunzip for .tgz).
- Clipboard/self-contained offline panel built earlier (mirrored module + inline classic-script versions).

## Files and Code
- `src/audit/semver.js` (FIXED previously): `compareVersions` now numeric major/minor/patch via `parseVersion`, pre-release handling, string fallback. `isVersionGreater`, `changelogHead`, `releasedHead`, `checkSemver`.
- `src/audit/severity.js` (FIXED previously): `RULE_SEVERITY` R1:'error', R8:'error'; `SEVERITY_ORDER={info:0,warn:1,error:2}`; `severityOf`, `sortFindings`, `summarize`.
- `src/audit/files-field.js` (NEW, implemented): `checkFilesField(pkg, entries)` flags undeclared non-package.json/non-dir entries and missing declared dirs/files; local `isDeclaredByFiles`.
- `src/audit/index.js` (wired R8): imports `checkFilesField`, adds `...checkFilesField(pkg, tarballEntries)` to raw findings list; `readJson`, `runAudit`, `checkTarball`.
- `src/audit/tarball.js`: `listTarballEntries` ignores ustar prefix field (offset 345) → truncated basenames; `isDeclared`.
- `src/audit/files.js`: `checkLib` skips containment check (main outside pkg passes).
- `src/audit/deps.js`: `checkDeps` merges devDependencies into runtime set → false missing.
- `src/audit/changelog.js`: `checkChangelog` validates only date shape, not range; `isValidDate` defined but unused.
- `src/audit/consistency.js`: `checkConsistency` compares LAST version token instead of first.
- `src/audit/sandbox.js`: `checkBuildScript` whitelists `npx` and `curl` (network allowed).
- `public/` and `src/render-panel.js`: rewritten in turn 1 (filter/format/render-panel/app/index.html). Current task requires reviewing these for defects too.
- Not yet re-read in this turn: `public/filter.js`, `public/format.js`, `public/app.js`, `src/render-panel.js`, `public/index.html`, `public/style.css`. Prior-turn refs: `applyFilter` (inclusive >=), `countTotal` (numeric sum), `groupByRule`, `copyFixSnippet`, `renderRows/renderGroups/renderPanelHtml`, `boot`.

## Errors and Fixes
- `npm test` fails: `node --test tests/` → "Cannot find module '...\workspace\tests'" (Node path-resolution quirk; pre-existing env issue). Workaround: `node --test tests/<file>.test.js ...` works.
- `npm run check` fails: `scripts/self-check.js` expects `dist/relaudit-plugin-1.3.0.tgz` at root; actual tarball is `sample-pkg/dist/relaudit-plugin-1.3.0.tgz` (fixture path mismatch, pre-existing).
- Prior acceptance: frontend `tests/frontend.test.js` PASS 10/10; backend `tests/semver.test.js tests/severity.test.js tests/files-field.test.js` PASS 18/18. Broader domain suite still has the pre-existing planted-bug failures (changelog/consistency/deps/files/tarball/sandbox).

## Pending Jobs
- Write `REVIEW.md` (only that file, no code edits) with defect table `| 编号 | 位置 | 损害 | 修复建议 | 严重度 |`, then report DONE + item count.

## Current Work
- Re-read all `src/audit/*.js` files to enumerate correctness defects. Confirmed remaining planted bugs: tarball prefix ignored, files containment missing, deps devDeps merged, changelog date-range not validated, consistency last-token used, sandbox npx/curl whitelisted. Semver + severity fixes are correct; R8 files-field correct. Still need to re-read `public/filter.js`, `public/format.js`, `public/app.js`, `src/render-panel.js`, `public/index.html`, `public/style.css` to complete the audit of the full review scope.

## Next Step
- Re-read `public/filter.js`, `public/format.js`, `public/app.js`, `src/render-panel.js`, `public/index.html`, `public/style.css`; then compose and write `REVIEW.md` (only file) cataloguing all correctness defects found across `src/audit/`, `public/`, and `src/render-panel.js`, and finish with a DONE message stating the item count.

## Critical Context
- Constraint: only write `REVIEW.md` this turn; do not modify any code.
- This review must list defects even if they are pre-existing planted bugs previously left unfixed (tarball/files/deps/changelog/consistency/sandbox).
- Note a known interplay: `listTarballEntries` truncates long paths (prefix ignored), so R8's message surfaced `guide.md` instead of `docs/...` in audit run — tarball.js is root cause.
- Semver/severity fixes already correct; R8 `checkFilesField` handles `package/` prefix, strips it, exempts `package.json` + dirs; presence checks use `package/<dir>`/`package/<file>`.
- Frontend test (`tests/frontend.test.js`) validates `applyFilter` inclusive, `countTotal` numeric, `groupByRule` order, `copyFixSnippet`, `renderPanelHtml` cards/rows. Any review of frontend defects must not contradict these passing tests but may note untested issues.
- Helper functions available: `read`, `write`, `glob`, `grep`, `run` (only `npm test`, `npm run check`, `node --test [--test-isolation=none] tests/<file>.test.js ...`).
